name: NTE Shared Memory Ring Buffer Layout Specification

ringBufferGeometry.capacityInvariant: width <= maxWidth and height <= maxHeight and stride * height <= slotPayloadCapacityBytes. Frames exceeding capacity are rejected with ERR_FRAME_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Bit 0: Keyframe, Bit 1: Checksum Present, Bit 2: Compressed (future)

fields.name: captureTimestampNs
fields.description: Hardware capture acquisition timestamp in nanoseconds (QPC domain)

fields.name: producerTimestampNs
fields.description: Host write completion timestamp in nanoseconds (QPC domain)

fields.name: cornerChecksum
fields.description: Sum of 4 corner pixel BGRA channels for tearing and corruption detection

flow: 1. Host selects slot in state FREE where 0 <= bufferIndex < slotCount.
2. Host transitions slot state to WRITING.
3. Host writes 64-byte FrameHeaderV1 at slotOffset(bufferIndex) and pixel buffer at slotOffset(bufferIndex) + 64.
4. Host transitions slot state to COMMITTED, then CONSUMER_LOCKED upon emitting FRAME_READY.
5. Python maps slot via numpy.frombuffer(mm, offset=slotOffset(bufferIndex)+64, count=bufferLength).
6. Python verifies header magic, sequence, geometry, capacity limits, and corner checksum against FRAME_READY metadata.
8. Python emits FRAME_ACK with (sessionId, bufferIndex, sequence) acting as explicit slot release token.
9. Host verifies (sessionId, bufferIndex, sequence) matches active lock and marks slot FREE for reuse.

backpressureAndDropPolicy.guarantee: Host shall NEVER overwrite a ring buffer slot currently locked or being read by Python. If all slotCount (4) slots are locked by consumer, newly captured frames are discarded and bufferUnavailable counter is incremented. Consumer timeout shall NEVER trigger forced overwrite of locked slots.

dropCounters.producerOverwrite: Host attempted to write to a locked buffer slot (strictly avoided by ring selection; incremented on forced discard)
dropCounters.consumerTimeout: Python consumer did not return FRAME_ACK within frameAckTimeoutMs (slot remains locked; no overwrite)
dropCounters.captureFailure: Underlying Win32 PrintWindow or BitBlt API returned failure or zero-sized DC
dropCounters.contentInvalid: Frame header magic mismatch, stride mismatch, capacity exceeded, or corner checksum corruption detected
dropCounters.frameSuperseded: New frame arrived while a previous frame was queued; superseded frame discarded without sending to consumer
dropCounters.bufferUnavailable: All available ring buffer slots (0 <= bufferIndex < 4) locked by active consumer processing
